title: AgenticAEGIS: Fail-Closed Runtime Guard for LLM Agent Actions and Plans
description:
AgenticAEGIS (Architectural Ethics Guard for Intelligent Systems) is a caller-agnostic policy decision point that checks actions and complete action plans of LLM agents against a deontic rule base before execution. Conflicting action norms are resolved with Olson's Defeasible Deontic Inheritance Calculus (DDIC); plan-level constraints cover sequences, aggregates, deadlines, and preconditions. Verdicts are PERMITTED, FORBIDDEN, or UNDECIDABLE, and anything outside the modeled space fails closed.

This release provides the software baseline for the accompanying manuscript Fail-Closed Plan Governance for LLM Agents: A Reproducible DDIC-Backed Runtime Guard for Normative Action Sequences, which is being prepared for submission and has not yet been published. It contains the runtime monitor, MELD domains, automated tests, adversarial plan scenarios, benchmarks, and TLA+ specifications.
